title: Upload fix + MultiACE overhaul
body:
Fixed uploads timing out on big G-code files. The timeout now scales with file
  size, so large prints reach the printer reliably. New Save button next to Upload lets you save G-code to your phone  for manual upload through the web UI. MultiACE tab rewritten against the real multiACE 0.99.2b status format:
  lanes now show spool colors and RFID info, dryer status with humidity, and the active unit. Dryer controls now use
  commands that work on ACE Pro V1 (previously ACE 2-only). If the tab shows nothing, update multiACE on your printer
  first (ACE_UPDATE_APPLY).

title: Big slicer update
body:
Multicolor prints now slice with their real colors. Pick a plate on multi-plate
  files. New Print Preprocessing popup before sending: choose printer, remap tool heads, see per-color filament use.
  Open .3mf/.stl files straight from your browser or file manager. New Supports, Infill, Ironing and Brim options on
  the prepare screen. Plus: fixed the tab bar hiding behind Android's navigation buttons.
